Featured Project

OpsPilot — GitOps Control Center

Multi-cluster, multi-Argo CD and multi-Git-provider GitOps infrastructure automation platform.

OpsPilot centralizes the management of Argo CD applications, Kubernetes clusters, Git repositories, deployment strategies (Blue-Green / Canary / Rolling), automatic rollbacks, monitoring, approvals and auditing — all behind a modern light/dark interface and a secured Express API.

4
Git providers
3
Deploy strategies
3
RBAC roles
AES-256
Encrypted secrets

Multi-Argo CD & multi-cluster

Register several Argo CD servers and Kubernetes clusters from the UI (Bearer token or kubeconfig), with connectivity tests and live metrics.

Multi-provider Git

GitHub, GitLab, Gitea and Bitbucket integration through webhooks and polling, with encrypted access tokens.

Branch-based environments

Extensible branch → environment mapping: main → Production, feature/* → Preview, and more.

Deployment strategies & rollback

Blue-Green, Canary and Rolling history, plus an automatic rollback engine with rules, cooldown and a detailed log.

Approvals & RBAC

Deploy, sync and rollback requests from operators validated by admins. Roles: platform-admin, operator, viewer.

Audit & notifications

Complete audit log of every action and an in-app notification center.

Observability

CPU, memory and pod history per cluster, an aggregated view, application logs and a consolidated dashboard.

Security by default

JWT authentication, AES-256-GCM encrypted Git tokens and webhook secrets, Helmet and CORS on the API.
